about: v0.2 dev pilot: OpenClaw (one session per conversation and one per turn), Hermes and QM on Haiku over the 15 v0.2 dev tasks: per-cell and per-task tables, harness-against-harness comparisons and the minimum detectable difference.

not_rebuilt.reason: Each shard's spend sheet came from scripts/reconcile-provider.ts run on that shard's own results folder before the shards were merged. That script only reads files named exactly trials.jsonl, proxy-usage.ndjson and ledger.sqlite in one folder, and the committed copies are the merged trials.jsonl plus the shard's files under a prefix (for example oc.ledger.sqlite), so the shard's own inputs aren't laid out the way the script needs.

scripts/regrade.ts exits with code 1 whenever a grade changes (13 do here), which verify treats as a failed step, and every line it writes carries the grader's commit id and the scratch folder's path, which verify can't skip in a JSON Lines file. A regrade by hand on 2026-11-09 gave the same grade, consent and approval result for all 180 trials; the lines differ only in the commit id, the evidence path and a 'moved' field the script added later.
